name: com.isgenai/checker
title: isGenAI
description: AI detector for images, text and links: reads C2PA, AI labels and saved prompts, adds an AI score.

tools.name: check_text
tools.description: AI text detector: check pasted text or code (up to 16,000 characters, 30 languages) for AI. Returns an AI-likelihood score with the reasons behind it (300+ characters, about 100 for Chinese, Japanese or Korean), flags chatbot leftovers such as ChatGPT citation tags and unfilled placeholders, and quotes any statement of AI use or named AI tool (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot) word for word. Use for: is this essay, email, post, review or code written by AI or ChatGPT? A score is an estimate, not proof of authorship. Private: no public report is created. Docs: https://isgenai.com/developers/mcp

text.description: The text or code to check.

kind.description: Use code for source code. Defaults to text.

tools.name: check_url
tools.description: Check a public web page or file URL for AI: fetches it and reads AI labels, AI-use statements, Content Credentials and saved creation records found there, with an AI-likelihood score for the image. Use for: is this article, news photo, product image or social post AI-generated or fake? Logins, paywalls and CAPTCHAs are not bypassed. No public report is created. Docs: https://isgenai.com/developers/mcp

url.description: Public http(s) URL. Private network and local addresses are refused.

tools.name: check_image
tools.description: AI image detector: check an image (PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF or single-page TIFF, up to 20 MiB) by public URL or base64. Reads the evidence in the file first (C2PA Content Credentials naming the generator or camera, IPTC AI labels, prompts saved by Stable Diffusion tools, EXIF), then adds an AI-likelihood score from the image detector. Use for: is this photo real or AI, is this a deepfake, was this made with Midjourney, DALL-E, Firefly or ChatGPT? A score is an estimate; records are evidence. No public report is created. Docs: https://isgenai.com/developers/mcp

url.description: Public http(s) URL. Private network and local addresses are refused.

image_base64.description: File bytes as base64 or a data: URL, up to 20 MiB decoded. Prefer url when the file is public.

tools.name: extract_saved_prompt
tools.description: Read the prompt, negative prompt, model and settings saved inside an image by AUTOMATIC1111, ComfyUI (including Flux workflows), InvokeAI or NovelAI. Only reads records stored in the file; it never reconstructs or guesses a prompt. Screenshots and re-uploads usually remove these records. Docs: https://isgenai.com/developers/mcp

url.description: Direct public URL of the original image file.

image_base64.description: File bytes as base64 or a data: URL, up to 20 MiB decoded. Prefer url when the file is public.

tools.name: read_content_credentials
tools.description: Read C2PA Content Credentials from an image, video, audio or PDF file (by public URL or base64, up to 20 MiB). Reports the manifest, recorded actions and digital source type, with cryptographic validation and signer trust as separate findings. Docs: https://isgenai.com/developers/mcp

url.description: Public http(s) URL. Private network and local addresses are refused.

file_base64.description: File bytes as base64 or a data: URL, up to 20 MiB decoded. Prefer url when the file is public.

media_type.description: MIME type of the base64 file, for example image/jpeg.

tools.name: estimate_x_ai_replies
tools.description: Estimate what share of the replies under an X (Twitter) post look AI-generated or bot-driven. Pass the reply texts with any author details (handle, bio, followers, following, joined date, default avatar) and timestamps you have; the post text and time sharpen the estimate. Returns the percentage, a band and a 0-100 score with signals for every reply. An estimate from patterns, not proof about any account. Docs: https://isgenai.com/x-ai-replies

replies.description: The replies to score, one object per reply.
